announcement.quote: SIERRA INCOME CORPORATION TO MERGE WITH BARINGS BDC, INC. AND COMBINED COMPANY TO BE MANAGED BY BARINGS LLC

outcome_evidence.quote: announced today the closing of the previously announced merger with Sierra Income Corporation (“Sierra”).

deals.notes: Barings BDC is shown as NYSE: BBDC; the excerpts do not show Sierra's listing status or ticker, so both_listed is null. Closing press release dated February 25, 2022 was filed in an 8-K on 2022-03-03.
